title: Safety of One Dose of Meningococcal ACWY Conjugate Vaccine in Subjects From 2 Months to 55 Years of Age in the Republic of South Korea
brief_summary: A multicenter, single arm, post-marketing surveillance study. This study is a postlicensure requirement of the Korea Food and Drug Administration (KFDA) to provide continued safety evaluation of MenACWY in the Korean population from 2 months to 55 years of age, receiving MenACWY-CRM vaccination according to routine clinical practice and prescribing information.
